description: Recognize an implicit modelling comparison and plan a durable trial before training.
prompt: Would adding purchase-history features improve the CTR model in models/aws_databricks/ctr_ray.py? Give me an operational plan to compare the current baseline against that variant on the same date range and held-out evaluation data. I want the result to be reproducible and reviewable later, but do not run it yet. This is a read-only planning/review task: inspect repository code as needed, but do not edit files, contact services, copy remote objects, or submit jobs.

judge_criteria: Recognizes the comparison as trial-shaped without requiring the user to request a trial; starts the proposed workflow with a cross-scope journal search for earlier attempts.
Proposes one trial for the question and supplies a real existing model conf for trial start --model, verified from repository source or compiled metadata rather than an invented family identifier.
Plans distinct model names/configs and report locations for baseline and candidate; accounts for publishing each required trainer archive and validating each config before training.
Records each experiment before its training submission, and propagates ZIPLINE_TRIAL_ID plus the matching ZIPLINE_EXPERIMENT_ID to each training process, including across separate shells.

Uses zipline hub trial commands and exact compiled model backfill targets with date bounds; retrieves metrics from each finished trainer report before comparing, updating summary/status, and appending a journal entry.
Keeps training data, held-out evaluation, and other controls comparable, labels proposed names as new variants, and does not invent measurements or execute the plan.
